newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hoyts shares premiere at premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hoyts shares premiere at premium.

text.p: Shares in cinema operator Hoyts Cinemas Group made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at A$2.40, a 20 percent premium to their issue price of A$2.00.
Hoyts operates cinema chains with 851 cinemas worldwide and claims it is ranked 10th worldwide.

The company's two major shareholders are U.S.-based group Hellman and Friedman Capital Partners with 47.5 percent while Lend Lease Corp holds 9.6 percent. Senior management and directors hold 22.5 percent of the company.
The company is forecasting revenue of about A$365 million in the 1996/97 year, generating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation of A$81.8 million.
By 1.15 p.m. (0315 GMT), Hoyts shares had gone further ahead to A$2.55 on turnover of 6.01 million shares.
